about.text: Camel's milk soured into a slightly acidic, sometimes fizzy and faintly alcoholic drink wherever camels are herded: shubat in Kazakhstan, chal in Turkmenistan, khoormog in Mongolia, gariss in Sudan and suusac in northern Kenya.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.
Some of the world’s 4 Mt of camel milk is drunk fermented.

facts.v: From thick to a thin, gassy, foaming drink
